title: Camouflage Series
description:
This textile series was created as my undergraduate graduation project, inspired by animals and their natural habitats.

I explored the colors, shapes, and patterns of different animals, transforming their distinctive features into textile designs inspired by the environments they live in. Each design is created by layering three colors.

Inspired by the idea of camouflage, I also incorporated subtle hidden patterns into the backgrounds, adding playful details for viewers to discover and enjoy.

By combining elements of animals and their habitats, I aimed to express the connection between living creatures and nature. Through decorative patterns, I hope to encourage viewers to appreciate the beauty of wildlife and become more aware of the natural world.
